operating_point.seeds_and_draws: DETECTION_SEED from 1000: the viscosity or the amplitude within a quarter of 1 mPa s or 1 mT; the pose's x from the axis to 0.1 mm

gate_11_proper.claim: derivatives through the coupled Schwarz solve by the implicit route, forward and reverse, agree with central differences: in the viscosity and the field's amplitude through two steps of the run, and in the body's position through the first preparation at the node

prediction.basis: measured-before at the undrawn values (seen_before) and derived: the difference's noise, the solves' tolerance over its relative step (1e-8 / h), and its truncation, h^2 where the map curves
prediction.why: every unknown of the step is a linear function of solves stopped at their tolerances, differentiated by their own tangent and transpose solves

gate_11_proper.metric: the relative miss; the run's Schwarz flags (none); the node's columns' residual

control.plant: stopped: jax.lax.stop_gradient on the reflection's output (MIME_PLANT_SCHWARZ=stopped); capped: the columns' GMRES capped at one product (MIME_PLANT_SCHWARZ=capped)
control.expected_rate: stopped: 3/3 on the viscosity (both modes) and the position (the operator moves with them, its reflection's part dropped); on the amplitude forward 0/3 (its tangent is the solve's own on a moved right-hand side, through no derivative of the operator: the plant cannot fail it, a non-discriminating pairing reported as such), reverse unknown before the run (the transposed operator's stop_gradient may drop the reflection from the transpose solve). capped: 3/3 by the run's flag (viscosity forward) and the node's residual (position)
control.resolution: the walls' reflection is the whole of the position's derivative (free space's near field does not move with the pose) and part of the viscosity's; a capped GMRES leaves a composed residual decades over its line

gate_11_proper.if_wrong: a clean miss over 1e-4: a tangent or transpose solve that is not the forward solve's (or a leaf baked at build); a stopped plant passing on the viscosity: the reflection's share of that derivative under the line
gate_11_proper.cannot_discriminate_if: the stopped plant on the amplitude in forward mode (above)

gate_11_proper.result: every case passes (the cases arm, seed 0): the viscosity forward 4.75e-8 and reverse 4.77e-8 off the difference; the amplitude forward 2.8e-9, reverse 9.6e-7; the position at the node forward and reverse equal to the printed digits, 2.1e-7 off the difference (its truncation); no run flagged, the node's columns converged
gate_11_proper.controls: stopped caught 3/3 on all five (the viscosity both modes, the amplitude both modes, the position), clean 0/3 each; capped caught 3/3 (the viscosity forward by the run's flag, the position by the node's residual), clean 0/3
gate_11_proper.against_the_prediction: WRONG on one point: the stopped plant was predicted unable to fail the amplitude's forward derivative (the tangent of a solve on a moved right-hand side, the operator unmoved); it failed it 3/3. The mechanism assumed was wrong: the tangent solve applies the products' linearisation, which a stop_gradient on the reflection zeroes, so the tangent is solved with the near field alone. The control discriminates every case (detection_rate keeps no record of a caught run, so the size of each planted miss is not in the artifact)
